translations.text: [?] they turn [it] into impurity and deny our only Master, our Lord Jesus Christ.
And the angels who did not keep their own dominion, but abandoned their dwelling, he has kept in eternal bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, which in the same way as these committed fornication and went in pursuit of strange flesh, lie before us as an example of eternal fire, having received punishment.
In the same way these also see visions, defile the flesh, despise lordship, and blaspheme glory.
When Michael the archangel was contending with the devil and disputing about the body of Moses, he did not dare to bring a judgment of blasphemy against him, but said: "May the Lord rebuke you."
But these people blaspheme whatever they do not know, and whatever they know by understanding, like irrational beasts, in these things they are corrupted.
Woe to them, for they walk in the way of Cain, and they were carried away in the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the rebellion of Korah.

These are the ones who, defiled at your love feasts, feast together with you and shepherd themselves without fear. They are waterless clouds swept about by the wind, fruitless winter trees, twice dead, pulled up by the roots.
They are raging waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the darkness of eternal gloom has been reserved.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about these and said: "Behold, the Lord came with myriads of his holy angels
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all the deeds of their ungodliness which they committed, and of all the harsh words which ungodly sinners have spoken."
These are grumblers [?], complainers, walking according to their own desires, and their mouth speaks arrogant things. Eyes [?]
